name: Ensembl VEP and release-116 plugin data

version.value: Ensembl release 116 (REST); plugin data directories dated 2025-10 to 2026-08

scope: Variant effect prediction tool with offline caches and pre-built data for plugins. Directory listing of release-116/variation shows: MaveDB, LOEUF, SpliceAI (27 GB raw/masked VCFs), SpliceVault, ProtVar, mutfunc, Enformer, GENCODE_promoter, PhenotypeOrthologous, RiboSeqORFs, pangenomes, vcf, gvf, indexed_vep_cache.
mapping_methods: VEP consequence calling against Ensembl/RefSeq transcripts; plugin files keyed by GRCh38 coordinates.

quantitative.summary: Plugin data carry their source scores (e.g. MaveDB scores, SpliceAI delta scores, LOEUF).

licence.name: Ensembl: no restrictions on data (verified); plugin resources carry upstream terms (e.g. gnomAD notes SpliceAI annotations as CC BY-NC 4.0)
licence.redistribution: Check each plugin resource before redistribution

update_frequency: With each Ensembl release; plugin files updated irregularly (MaveDB file dated 2026-03-09).
coverage_limitations: Plugin documentation page returned HTTP 504 when probed, so the complete plugin list and per-plugin licences are not verified
SpliceAI/Enformer/mutfunc/ProtVar/SpliceVault files are very large (1 to 27 GB)
known_omissions: Only directory names were verified for plugins other than MaveDB; their contents were not opened

reuse_decision.rationale: Ensembl already integrates MaveDB, LOEUF, SpliceAI, SpliceVault, ProtVar, mutfunc and Enformer for VEP; reuse these rather than re-deriving them. The MaveDB file is acquired first to measure overlap with the API-built set.

status.notes: FTP listings reachable; MaveDB CHECKSUMS file lists BSD sum 22727 / 547461 KiB.
